name: Maternity Monsters! ~Jinrou Kaichou to Yuisho Tadashiki Kozukuri Sengen!~
original_name: またにてぃもんすたぁず！～神狼会長と由緒正しき子作り宣言！～
source:
Monster girls have an almost impossible time becoming pregnant. Only about .2% of the time having sex can one get pregnant. For this end a special school has been created. Here humans and monster girls can attend school together where daily sex is required and open sex is encouraged.

After his marriage to [url=/v9979]Hakua[/url] Taichi lives every day now in lovey dovey baby making sex with his wife. He runs into Ooko the student council president (quite literally). Ooko is strict and hard to approach. Because of this nobody has asked her to be their baby making partner. Although sad that she's alone she will not change her attitude or her duty to the school. Leaving her with little hope of finding a partner.

When Taichi calls her cute, instead of 'strong' or 'cool' like all the other students her heart begins to beat. Meanwhile Taichi thinks to himself that, since it's all right to marry many monster girls he should have lots of wives and make lots of children so he decides to show Ooko love and happiness.
translation:
魔物娘极难怀孕，每次性交的受孕概率仅约为0.2%。为解决这个问题，人们建立了一所特殊学校。人类与魔物娘在这里共同就读，每天都必须性交，校方还鼓励学生公开交媾。

与[url=/v9979]哈克亚[/url]结婚后，大地每天都和妻子甜蜜恩爱，为生育孩子而尽情做爱。一天，他与学生会长狼牙峰奥子撞了个正着——字面意义上的相撞。奥子为人严厉，难以亲近，因此从未有人邀请她成为自己的生育伴侣。尽管独自一人令她难过，她仍不肯改变处事态度，也不会放下对学校的职责，这让她几乎不可能找到伴侣。

其他学生只会称赞奥子“强大”或“帅气”，大地却说她很可爱，令她顿时心跳加速。与此同时，大地想到，既然可以迎娶多名魔物娘，自己就应该多娶几位妻子，生下许多孩子。于是，他决定让奥子感受到爱与幸福。
